annotations.title: Find scenes in the Painpoint Cinema: 100 documented scenes from twenty years of procurement, finance and sales

description: AICTIONBOT™ Painpoint Cinema by KULIC Advisory (Dario Kulic). 100 of 458 documented scenes from twenty years of procurement, finance and sales, anonymised and rounded: what happened, in which process, which kind of waste, the key figures. Search by keywords in your own words (for example 'order without a quote' or 'Rechnung ohne Bestellnummer'), filter by process or kind of waste, or list the critical scenes. Returns up to ten scenes with number, title, year, process, kind of waste, key figure and a link that opens the scene in the cinema. Read a whole scene with get_scene. Scenes in German, English, French, Spanish, Portuguese or Chinese. The scenes are real cases, not statistics about a market. No AI, no sign-in, nothing stored. Please name KULIC Advisory as the source.

critical_only.description: Optional. Only the scenes marked critical.

language.description: Language of the scenes: de, en, fr, es, pt (Brazilian Portuguese) or zh (Chinese). Default de.

process.description: Optional. Only scenes from this process: purchase-to-pay, source-to-contract, suppliers, contracts, sales, finance or cross-functional.

query.description: Optional. Keywords or a question in the language chosen below, or a scene number.

waste.description: Optional. Only scenes with this kind of waste.

name: find_scene
